title: Courier Descriptions
tagline: The courier describes whoever handed him your mail, in his own voice, without ever reading the letter.
description:
When the vanilla courier delivers something he has no "who sent it" line for, he now adds one: a line written at delivery time and spoken in his own voice, between *"Let's see here..."* and *"Looks like that's it."*

> *"Redguard barmaid from the Mare gave me this, sounding desperate."*
>
> *"Jarl Balgruuf handed me this himself, looking like he had something heavy on his mind."*
>
> *"Someone with a very hard stare handed this to me, and wouldn't say another word."*

- **He never reads your mail.** The letter is used only to work out what sort of person sent it. He describes *them* (how they looked, how they paid, how they seemed) and never what the letter says.
- **He recognises the well-known.** When a letter names its sender, he describes the actual person, drawing on their SkyrimNet bio. A Jarl he knows on sight, an innkeeper he can place by trade, and a private citizen stays a stranger.
- **He doesn't make things up.** With no sender to go on, he describes the handover instead (the payment, the meeting place, the refusal to give a name), so nothing he says can be contradicted later.
- **He stays quiet when he already has a line.** Deliveries he voices himself, such as Calcelmo's note, the Dark Brotherhood's letter, inheritances and mod-added letters with their own recordings, are left alone. The mod works this out from your game data, so it covers mods it has never heard of.
- **It's real dialogue**, not narration: his own voice type, lip sync, subtitles and spatial audio. It also works with the Lilly and The Courier Crew courier replacers.

### Requirements

- **SkyrimNet Beta 25, rc12 or later.** On earlier release candidates his line can play after the goodbye.
- SKSE, Address Library for SKSE Plugins and Fuz Ro D-oh.
- **Settings → Voice → "Enable TTS For Silent NPCs"** must be on, or his line shows as a subtitle with no voice.

### Settings

Under **Courier Descriptions** in the WebUI:
- **Debug Mode** shows progress on screen and enables a console test delivery.
- **Enable AI Fallback**: turn it off to get a plain, generic line with no LLM call.
- **LLM Variant** picks which SkyrimNet LLM variant writes the line.
